# NZ Gym Guide

NZ Gym Guide is an independent gym comparison site for New Zealand.
We compare gym memberships, prices, contracts, and features across major NZ gym chains.

## What We Cover

- Side-by-side gym membership comparisons (price, contract, features)
- City guides: Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton, Tauranga, Dunedin
- Gym reviews for Anytime Fitness, Les Mills, Jetts, Snap Fitness, Gym Society, and more
- Free 'Find My Gym' quiz to match users to the best gym for their needs
- Cheapest gym guides and 24/7 gym guides for NZ
- Free diet plans (lose weight, gain muscle, feel healthier)
- Current gym deals and promotions

## Key Pages

- Compare all gyms: https://nzgymguide.co.nz/compare/
- Find My Gym quiz: https://nzgymguide.co.nz/quiz/
- Auckland gyms: https://nzgymguide.co.nz/gym/auckland/
- Wellington gyms: https://nzgymguide.co.nz/gym/wellington/
- Cheapest gym NZ: https://nzgymguide.co.nz/guides/cheapest-gym-nz/
- Best 24/7 gym NZ: https://nzgymguide.co.nz/guides/best-247-gym-nz/
